articles.title: Lawrence Butler clobbers massive homer to put Athletics on board vs. Rays
articles.description: Athletics outfielder Lawrence Butler hits a home run in the sixth inning against the Tampa Bay Rays on Thursday at Tropicana Field.

articles.title: Mark Kotsay offers blunt assessment after Athletics get ‘ass kicked' by Rays
articles.description: Athletics manager Mark Kotsay speaks with the media after his team's 10-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Thursday at Tropicana Field.

articles.title: Athletics prospect Ryan Lasko released from rehab facility after paralyzation
articles.description: Two months after a collision in the outfield paralyzed him, Athletics prospect Ryan Lasko has been released from a rehab facility and is heading home.

articles.title: Athletics prospect Leo De Vries reportedly will have surgery, miss eight months
articles.description: Leo De Vries, the Athletics' top prospect, reportedly will undergo shoulder surgery and be out for potentially up to eight months.

articles.title: Athletics' first four-homer inning since 2002 fuels close road win over Mariners
articles.description: The Athletics mashed four home runs in the span of six batters during a 7-6 win over the Seattle Mariners on Friday at T-Mobile Park.

articles.title: A's continue to play spoiler thanks to Donovan Walton's two-run walk-off homer
articles.description: Donovan Walton hit a two-run walk-off home run in the 10th inning to give the A's a 6-5 win over the Mariners as the team continues to plays spoiler.

articles.title: Athletics' mistakes on field lead to series sweep by red-hot Rays on Wednesday
articles.description: On "A's Cast," Dave Benz and Shooty Babitt discuss the Athletics' 10-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Thursday at Tropicana Field.

articles.title: Athletics can't stay afloat, drop series in another loss to AL-best Rays
articles.description: On "A's Cast," Chris Townsend and Shooty Babitt discuss the Athletics' 4-3 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Wednesday at Tropicana Field.

articles.title: Athletics' bullpen falters in ninth inning for walk-off loss against Rays
articles.description: On "A's Cast," Chris Townsend and Shooty Babitt discuss the Athletics' 2-1 loss to the Tampa Bay Rays on Tuesday at Tropicana Field.
